notes.title: 'Time of the Moon's Hidden Event Quiz
notes.content:
Hi, Guardians! 
I’ve pretended a special event for you!
Do you know a lot of TOTM's hidden events?
I made 24’s question about events for you!
If you can correct all the problems, send me an email!(dawnfox06@gmail.com)I'll gift for 10 people in answerers who submitted correctly : a chance to be my new game tester!
Or if you find events that excluded in my quizzes please comment here!
I'm looking forward you to finding my special events!
Have a great time in Lunaris!

Ch 0.

0. Basic: Talk to Libra Many Times

In Stellance

1. How many dwarfs repair teleport magic circle?
2. What is the name of the 2nd Leo?
3. What are the characteristics of Virgo's favorite monsters?

In the square on fire

4. What does Cancer do to scold Leo in the square?
5. Write one word that Virgo says in the maze.


Ch 1.

8. What're Cancer's belongings?

10. What should be written in the input window in the Virgo and Libra's conversation?
11. What are the names of the two people on the message stone?

Ch 2.
12. What did Cancer say when he was moving to this town?
13. Why did Cancer sighing in the pub street?
14. What happens when you try to communicate with Canner in the last riddle of the bar warehouse?

Ch 3

17. Why did Cancer feel sick?

Ch 4.

Ch 5.

21. What is the location of Libra and Virgo after the meeting?
22. What does an apprentice Scorpion say when talks to him several times before starting training?

notes.title: English version update Sale
notes.content:
‘Time of the Moons’ English version has been updated.

It was inspected by an English professor to reduce awkward expressions as many as possible.
I've made a lot of effort to avoid weird translations.

However, there still can be some mistakes I've missed because the main story is 175 pages and the NPC dialogue is about 100 pages.
There are too many hidden events in my game and I assume that there are more things that I missed.

If you see Korean or strange translation please send an e-mail.(dawnfox06@gmail.com). I will fix it with a laugh.

The sale will be starting on Aug 6, at 10:00 am.

I want you to have a wonderful adventure time in 'Time of the moon'. 
Thank you!

notes.title: About Update English version
notes.content:
I am happy to tell you the good news.

‘Time of the Moon’s English version will be added soon.

It will be updated in the first week of August and at the latest in the second week.
I thank the people who waited!

Thank you.
